title: Which tool serves the goal?
hook: Two digital tools earn invented goal points according to explicit success chances.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to compare tools using a declared goal score and its assumptions, without treating that score as universal value

misconception: The tool with the largest best-case benefit necessarily contributes most to a chosen goal.
objective: Compare tools using a declared goal score and its assumptions, without treating that score as universal value.
